environmentVariables.description: External command that reorders query_documents results (unset disables reranking). The search query and the matched document chunks, including their text, are passed to this command, so a command that contacts a remote service sends that content off this machine.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_RERANK_CMD

environmentVariables.description: Time budget per rerank call in milliseconds (100-600000, defaults to 10000). On timeout the spawned command is killed and the pre-rerank ordering is returned.
environmentVariables.name: RAG_RERANK_TIMEOUT_MS
